sections.title: The courts are the easy part.

items.title: Empty courts at 3 PM on a Tuesday
items.body: Peak hours sell themselves; the rest of the week doesn’t.
items.fix: A weekly social with paid booking and a waitlist, at the hours you need filled.

items.title: Members who only book peak slots
items.body: And never meet anyone outside their usual four.
items.fix: Socials that rotate partners, with a member price or entry included.

items.title: Coaches and partners you can’t measure
items.body: Who actually brought new players in?
items.fix: A link per coach, partner and post, followed through to bookings.

sections.title: Partners rotate. Matches stay close.
sections.lead: Players book with a level. {{brand.name}} plans each round across your courts so nobody plays with the same partner twice until they’ve played with everyone at their level.

sections.title: From empty courts to a waitlist.

steps.title: Levels in, courts balanced
steps.body: Each booking brings a level. Rounds are planned so every match is close.

steps.title: Check in, level confirmed
steps.body: Players confirm their level at the desk. Walk-ins join the next round.

steps.title: A new partner every round
steps.body: Phones buzz with the next court and partner between games.

steps.title: Fair court time
steps.body: Anyone falling behind goes on next; anyone sitting out is pointed to the café.

steps.title: Standings, and the next session
steps.body: Standings go out with the photos; non-members who keep coming get a membership invitation.

examples.title: Socials and members together
examples.body: The cap. Everything above it is yours.

items.question: Does {{brand.name}} replace our court booking system?
items.answer: No. Keep your booking system for court hire. {{brand.name}} runs the socials and memberships on top.

items.question: Which sports work?
items.answer: Pickleball, padel, badminton, tennis and anything played in pairs on courts. You set the courts and round length.

items.question: Can members play free?
items.answer: Yes. A membership can include sessions at 100% off, or a member price.

items.question: Can coaches run sessions on {{brand.name}}?
items.answer: Yes. Add them to your team, and give each coach a link to see who they bring in.

items.question: Do players need an app?
items.answer: No. They book and see their next court in their phone’s browser.

items.question: We have several locations.
items.answer: Each location can have its own page. Ask us for a walkthrough on WhatsApp and we’ll set it up.
